selector_audit.declared: Count each distinct delivered pinned-base read observation once per path; rank paths by observation count, recency, and width; select the widest observation from up to four paths.
selector_audit.executed: Count every confirmed receipt presentation of a delivered read when ranking paths.
selector_audit.reason: The executed frequency field summed confirmed_receipts lengths, while the Round 30 H45 diagnostic incremented once per read_observations entry.

scientific_posture: The live run is not a clean implementation test of H50. Because closure is post-response and model-facing bytes are identical, the declared selector can be reconstructed from the sealed fresh trajectories as counterevidence, but another run on these identities is forbidden.
